text:
[issue by JoanFo1456]
### Describe the bug

On 1.21 the suspend button recently added it doesn't suspend the jobs.

### How to reproduce the bug

Create a job for the terminal, for example crafting and try to suspend it.

### Expected behavior

It should suspend the work and display "Resume" (or similar)

### Additional details

_No response_

### Which minecraft version are you using?

1.21

### On which mod loaders does it happen?

Forge, NeoForge

### Crash log

This doesn't create a crash log

I can't reproduce this.
Is this in singleplayer or multiplayer?
can you please post a crash log (hold F3 + C for 10 seconds to create one)

Are you using a quantum computer? I have not yet added support for that functionality. Working on it now.
